title: Fall — God Paints the Leaves
memory_verse: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease." — Genesis 8:22 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about the fall season and how God changes the colors of the leaves.
content: Fall is one of four seasons God made! In fall, the weather gets cooler and the days get shorter.
God paints the leaves beautiful colors — red, orange, yellow, and brown! The leaves fall gently from the trees to the ground.
Animals get ready for winter in fall. Squirrels gather nuts and birds fly south to warmer places. God takes care of every creature!
We can enjoy fall by picking apples, jumping in leaf piles, and thanking God for the harvest!
activity: Go outside and collect colorful fall leaves. Sort them by color. Then glue your favorite leaves on paper to make a fall picture. Write 'God made fall!' on your picture.
discussion: What colors do leaves turn in the fall?
What do squirrels do in the fall?
What is your favorite thing about fall?
